Every sentence must comply: the floor is a live decidable excess and never extinction; no count-level sentence without second seeds at the named k; exact re-runs under identical seeds are instrument determinism and never replication; (3,4] admits no cliff-at-4, completion, or sub-sub-interval reading and the multiplicative prior stays BROKEN-AUTHORITY; k=8's two draws are BAND-level only and carry no count verdict.

RAT-3 discipline: every preregistered branch conjunct is written out IN FULL in preregistration-skeleton.md and that text is the binding version. No section of the proposal may paraphrase a branch conjunct (the inverted CC3-NONMONO paraphrase, DEV-S2b-1, is why this rule exists).

Carry the AMEND-1 counter-inconsistency gate VERBATIM from DEC-20260901-6f9de3 as the standing gate for the frozen 582ea9 instrument lineage (ratified RAT-2) and apply it to every analysis-bearing receipt the design would produce, including the saturation-aware overflow identity at higher exposure.

The decision rule is preregistered, fixed-order, mutually exclusive and exhaustive, with named branch outcomes and a DOMAIN (which k, which seeds, which exposure) fixed pre-arm. Every conditional dependence is an explicit NUMBERED heuristic with a formal statement, a falsification condition, and a validation route inside the same proposal: at minimum the Poisson counting model, independence across seeds, exposure additivity, instrument stationarity across a longer arm, and any cap or HIT_LOG_CAP interaction with the estimator.
